result:
The default changed in commit `6e8da1b1` (PR #3412, "(fix) Update Default Procedure Status Concept"). Its author is Jayasanka Weerasinghe, and it is dated 2026-06-23. The status concept UUID default moved from the CIEL "Medication dispense status" concept, `167157AAAA…`, to the new published concept `f0d47b45-8303-4cdc-a9f2-c37135a3700f`. The status source type default moved from `Concept set` to `Answer to`. The commit also removed the TODO that said to update the value once a procedure-status concept set existed.

The ticket is not recorded. The commit and PR message carry only `(#3412)` with no ticket key, and a search of commit messages across all 42 repos found no other reference to the new UUID. The only ticket tied to the status config is O3-5653, which wired the body-site and status concepts in the original feature commit `6797e139`. I did not count that as the answering ticket.

Evidence, best first:
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/src/config-schema.ts:43-54` has the new status defaults.
- The fix commit `6e8da1b1` changed those defaults and removed the TODO.
- PR #3412 is the pull request that made the change.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/src/workspaces/procedures-form/procedures.form.component.tsx:131-134` is where the form uses the status config to search for choices.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/README.md:51-52` still documents the old defaults (`167157AAAA…`, `Concept set`), so it is stale.
- Commit `6797e139` (O3-5077) introduced the status config and the original TODO.
